issue_context.title: Replay SPM depends on playback rate
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** 
(Probably duplicate of #9821 ? But this is with replays.)
When Autoplay:
If playback rate>1, SPM will be more than 477, up to 955 SPM with 2x playback rate
If playback rate<1, SPM will be less than 477, down to 238 SPM with 0.5x playback rate

You can use a random replay without Autoplay and it's also able to reproduce this
**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
![osu_2020-09-10_18-58-52](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50285552/92720791-b7f32d00-f397-11ea-9c49-ae8022c5c2b0.jpg)
![osu_2020-09-10_18-58-55](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50285552/92720819-c04b6800-f397-11ea-8184-1133d3da0803.jpg)

**osu!lazer version:** 
2020.903.0
**Logs:**
Not needed

review_comments: Could you explain where I went wrong with this before? With this change it feels like the test is testing something else entirely (I meant to simulate DT/HT without actually applying DT/HT as it's more involved).
i find the comment here very hard to parse, will need to take another look at it.

To be fair now that I think about it, I'm pretty sure the previous code is a hack to bypass the fact that autoplay doesn't generate spinner frames correctly when rate mods are applied. But all of this rate-affecting stuff is super confusing, so I might well be talking nonsense.
Has this been addressed to not be required?
I suggest you read through this and make your own judgement. As far as I can tell it was not doing what we want.
Yeah I think it is fine to go with this. Spinner autoplay is broken right now with rate affecting mods and should be fixed properly.
